title: Currency conversion
sentences: An exchange rate describes one currency in terms of another.
If a practice rate is 55 pesos per US dollar, multiply dollars by 55 to get pesos.
Divide pesos by 55 to get dollars.
Lesson rates are illustrative, not live market rates; real transactions may also include fees.
At the illustrative rate of 55 pesos per dollar, convert 1,375 pesos to dollars.
55 pesos equals 1 dollar, so group the pesos into sets of 55.
The result is 25.00 US dollars under this practice rate, before any fees.
